steps.title: 检查磁盘空间
steps.hint: 建议预留 ≥40GB（ComfyUI + CUDA torch + INT8/Turbo INT8 蒸馏权重）。空间不够会停在这一步。

qwenimage.disk.low_space.zh: 磁盘剩余约 {free}GB，低于建议的 {want}GB（ComfyUI + torch + 两档权重）。清理磁盘或换一个剩余空间足够的安装目录后重跑。
qwenimage.disk.low_space.en: the disk has about {free}GB free, below the suggested {want}GB (ComfyUI + torch + both weight sets). Free some space or pick another install directory and re-run.

steps.title: 准备 ComfyUI 源码
steps.hint: 下载官方 ComfyUI（走国内镜像），解包到安装目录。

qwenimage.comfy.download_failed.zh: ComfyUI 源码下载失败。确认能访问 {urls} 之一，或手动把 ComfyUI 解包到「安装目录\ComfyUI」后重跑本脚本（已存在会跳过这一步）。
qwenimage.comfy.download_failed.en: could not download the ComfyUI source. Make sure one of {urls} is reachable, or unpack ComfyUI into <install dir>\ComfyUI by hand and re-run (an existing checkout is reused).

qwenimage.comfy.extract_failed.zh: ComfyUI 压缩包解开后没有顶层目录：包不完整。删掉临时 zip 重跑。
qwenimage.comfy.extract_failed.en: the ComfyUI archive had no top-level folder: the download is incomplete. Delete the temp zip and re-run.

steps.title: 建立隔离 venv 与 CUDA torch
steps.hint: 在 ComfyUI 目录里建 venv，装 CUDA 版 torch（cu128）与 ComfyUI 依赖。

qwenimage.venv.no_python.zh: 没找到可用的 Python 3.11 / 3.12。装一个并把 python 放进 PATH（或装 py 启动器）后重跑。
qwenimage.venv.no_python.en: no usable Python 3.11 / 3.12 was found. Install one and put python on PATH (or install the py launcher), then re-run.

qwenimage.venv.create_failed.zh: 创建 venv 失败（{venv}）。多为 Python 安装不完整或磁盘权限问题，换一个 Python 后重跑。
qwenimage.venv.create_failed.en: creating the venv failed ({venv}). Usually an incomplete Python install or a permission issue; try another Python and re-run.

qwenimage.venv.torch_failed.zh: CUDA 版 torch 没装成。检查网络与驱动（需要 NVIDIA 驱动支持 cu128），或手动装好 torch 后重跑。
qwenimage.venv.torch_failed.en: CUDA torch could not be installed. Check the network and driver (cu128 needs a recent NVIDIA driver), or install torch by hand and re-run.

qwenimage.venv.pip_failed.zh: ComfyUI 依赖安装失败（venv：{venv}）。看上面 pip 的报错尾部，修好后重跑即可（已装的包会跳过）。
qwenimage.venv.pip_failed.en: installing ComfyUI requirements failed (venv: {venv}). Check the pip error tail above, fix it and re-run (installed packages are reused).

steps.title: 下载 Qwen Image 2.1 权重
steps.hint: INT8（默认，7.3GB）+ Turbo INT8（7.3GB）扩散模型 + qwen3vl_8b 文本编码器（9.4GB）+ qwen_image_2.1 VAE；两档共用编码器与 VAE。ModelScope 优先，回退 hf-mirror。

qwenimage.weights.download_failed.zh: 权重下载失败：{tail}。脚本会依次试 ModelScope 与 hf-mirror 上的 Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1（同一份 ComfyUI repack）。都不行时，把已下好的文件放进安装目录对应子目录（或安装窗里选「已下载的权重目录」）后重跑。
qwenimage.weights.download_failed.en: weight download failed: {tail}. The script tries ModelScope, then hf-mirror, both from the same Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1 ComfyUI repack. If neither works, place the files into the matching subfolders (or pick "already downloaded weights" in the install window) and re-run.

steps.title: 校验权重与运行环境
steps.hint: 逐个检查 ComfyUI、venv、INT8 / Turbo INT8 权重、文本编码器与 VAE 是否就位。

qwenimage.files.missing.zh: 收尾校验不通过，缺：{err}。补齐后重跑安装。
qwenimage.files.missing.en: final check failed, missing: {err}. Add them and re-run the installer.

steps.title: 启动一次后端并校验原生节点
steps.hint: 临时起 ComfyUI（8196），确认 /object_info 里有 TextEncodeQwenImage21 节点后关闭。

qwenimage.smoke.backend_failed.zh: ComfyUI 起来了但没暴露 TextEncodeQwenImage21（{err}）。多为 ComfyUI 版本过旧（需 0.4x 之后带 Qwen Image 2.1 原生节点的版本）：更新 ComfyUI 源码后重跑；日志尾部：{tail}
qwenimage.smoke.backend_failed.en: ComfyUI started but never exposed TextEncodeQwenImage21 ({err}). Usually an outdated ComfyUI checkout (Qwen Image 2.1 native nodes need a recent build): update the source and re-run. Log tail: {tail}
